title: architect generate, and handler scaffolds
summary: architect generate brings a project's generated code in line with its blueprint, the same as nx sync, and tells you what it changed. Each operation that has no blanks left gets a handler scaffold, written once and yours from then on. An operation with a blank gets nothing yet; fill it in and the next run scaffolds it. Run it twice and the second run says nothing to change.
proves: From acme's blueprint with no implementation, generate creates the four operation scaffolds and none for a blank operation; filled in, that one is scaffolded; a further run changes nothing.

captions.01-generate-test: The test: four scaffolds, none for the blank pause; filled in, pause gets its scaffold and generated files; then nothing to change.
captions.02-generate-session: A real session: add a blank operation, generate, generate again, and the spend scaffold it wrote.
